title: Loop state
description: profiles/<slug>/loops/<id>.state.json: what an automation remembers between checks. Type LoopState in src/core/types.ts; written by Store.saveLoopState (compact JSON, final newline, atomic temp+rename) from src/schedules/loops.ts. The reader (Store.getLoopState) merges the file over defaults ({seen: [], primed: false, failures: 0, backoffUntil: null, lastFound: 0, lastItems: []}), so the daemon always writes every field but threads, which state saved before threads lacks (read as {}). seen must survive: it stops the same item making a second ticket. Unknown fields must be kept.

seen.description: Every item id it has found, kept for good.

primed.description: False until the first check after it was switched on (that check only notes what is already there).

lastFound.description: How many items the last check found.

threads.description: Map: thread (Item.thread) to the ticket id its first item made; later items of the thread go into that ticket.

seenItem.description: LoopSeenItem: an item of the last check, for the editor's 'Last check found'.

state.description: new: became a ticket; added: went into its thread's ticket; waiting: its thread's ticket can't take it now; skipped: Claude said no ticket; seen: found before; first: found by the first check.
